睁眼的刹那，上官程差点从床上翻下去。

入目一片白花花的肌肤。霖多多不知道什么时候把睡衣蹭掉了，整个人像只八爪鱼似的趴在他身上，脸埋在他颈窝里，呼吸滚烫，带着浓重的酒气。

她的皮肤在月光下泛着温润的光，像一块上好的羊脂玉。

上官程的瞳孔猛地一缩，整个人像被点了穴一样僵住了。

他的大脑在这一刻彻底宕机，所有的理智、冷静、自持，全被这具温热的、柔软的、毫无防备的身体冲击得七零八落。

他甚至能感觉到她的心跳，透过那层薄薄的皮肤，一下一下地撞在他的胸口上，像一只莽撞的小鹿在敲一扇不该敲的门。

“好热……”霖多多喃喃着，脸在他颈窝里蹭了蹭，像只找舒服位置的猫，“渴。”

她的声音沙哑而慵懒，带着醉酒后特有的软糯，尾音拖得长长的，像一把小钩子，勾在上官程的心尖上。

“好，我去倒水。”

上官程目视天花板，声音平静得连他自己都觉得假。他试图起身，刚一动，就被女孩抱了个紧。

“不许跑！”霖多多手臂收拢，整个人像树袋熊一样挂在他身上，语气蛮横又娇憨，“陪着我！你这个总出故障的小……小坏蛋。”

她大着舌头，吐字不清，那个“小坏蛋”说得软绵绵的，像棉花糖落在心上。

上官程僵在原地，能感觉到自己耳根在发烫，那热度顺着脖子一路蔓延下去，像野火燎原，怎么都压不住。

他下意识地低头看了一眼，又迅速把目光钉回天花板上，喉结上下滚动了一下。

欲望怎么来的这么凶这么快？！

他突然想起常野说的那句“有副作用”。

原来就是这个？

妈的！

他闭上眼睛，深吸一口气，强迫自己冷静下来。女孩还趴在他身上，毫无防备，嘴里不知道在嘟囔什么，偶尔蹦出几个含糊不清的词，像是在做梦。

他还没对她表露心意，她也没对他说过喜欢。所以他们决不能发生关系，这是原则。

为了防止自己做出什么疯狂且不道德的事，上官程决定再把魂魄迁回机器体。

然而他刚闭上眼睛，一团柔软突然落在了唇瓣上，带着浓浓的酒香，还有女孩喃喃不清的声音：“我好喜欢你啊，阿九。”

上官程的眼眸猛地撑大。

“你说什么？”他的声音有些发紧，像被人掐住了喉咙。

The moment he opened his eyes, Shangguan Cheng almost fell off the bed.

A piece of white skin comes into view.Lin Duoduo didn't know when she took off her pajamas, and she lay on top of him like an octopus, her face buried in the crook of his neck, her breath hot and smelling of alcohol.

Her skin glowed warmly in the moonlight, like a piece of fine mutton-fat jade.

Shangguan Cheng's pupils shrank suddenly, and his whole body froze as if his acupoints had been tapped.

His brain completely shut down at this moment, and all his rationality, calmness, and self-control were shattered to pieces by this warm, soft, and defenseless body.

He could even feel her heartbeat, hitting his chest through the thin layer of skin, like a reckless deer knocking on a door that shouldn't be knocked.

"It's so hot..." Lin Duoduo murmured, rubbing her face into the crook of his neck, like a cat looking for a comfortable position, "Thirsty."

Her voice was hoarse and lazy, with the characteristic softness of drunkenness, and the last note was long and drawn out, like a small hook hooked on the apex of Shangguan Cheng's heart.

"Okay, I'll get some water."

Shangguan Cheng stared at the ceiling, his voice so calm that even he thought it was fake.He tried to get up, but as soon as he moved, the girl hugged him tightly.

"Don't run!" Lin Duoduo folded his arms and hung on him like a koala. His tone was arrogant and cute, "Stay with me! You little... little villain who always breaks down."

She had a big tongue and couldn't pronounce the words clearly. The "little villain" spoke softly, like marshmallows falling on her heart.

Shangguan Cheng froze on the spot, and could feel his ears burning. The heat spread all the way down his neck, like wildfire starting a prairie fire, and he couldn't suppress it no matter what.

He glanced down subconsciously, then quickly fixed his gaze back to the ceiling, his Adam's apple rolling up and down.

How come desire comes so fiercely and so quickly?!

He suddenly remembered what Chang Ye said, "It has side effects."

So this is it?

Oh shit!

He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and forced himself to calm down.The girl was still lying on top of him, defenseless, mumbling something unknown, occasionally uttering a few vague words, as if she was dreaming.

He hasn't expressed his feelings to her yet, and she hasn't told him that she likes him.So they must never have a relationship, this is the principle.

In order to prevent himself from doing something crazy and immoral, Shangguan Cheng decided to transfer his soul back to the machine body.

However, as soon as he closed his eyes, a soft ball suddenly fell on his lips, with a strong aroma of wine, and the girl's inarticulate voice: "I like you so much, Ah Jiu."

Shangguan Cheng's eyes widened suddenly.

"What did you say?" His voice was a little tight, as if someone had strangled his throat.
